[ota-hal] OTA-1738 — the game teaches what it runs (task list 4E91C7)

Player-teaching repair pass under the eleven locked owner decisions. No
mechanic, price, yield, cap or balance rule is touched; every teaching
surface now describes the rule the engine actually runs, and no two
optional cards can land on one beat.

Copy, in one place
- app/components/teachingRegistry.ts holds every first-use card (id,
  title, body, group, trigger line). Rules are quoted from the constants
  that run them: REINFORCE_MAX_LEVEL, REPLACEMENT_DOG_PRICE /
  FACTION_DOG_PRICE, scrapSuccessChance, COATING_DOT_TURNS,
  LOYALTY_DECAY_HOURS + DOG_LOYALTY_BANDS (new, dogCompanion),
  STAMINA_COSTS.wander (moved to app/engine/staminaCosts.ts, re-exported by
  the store), PITY_KILL_INTERVAL (app/engine/resurrectionRules.ts).
- Cards whose rule changed carry new ids: torch_first_v2 (each USE spends
  one torch — not a lamp burning while lit), golem_first_v2 (fed its own
  parts, or a trader; kits do not heal it), combat_throw_spear_v2 (one
  spear spent on every concluded throw, hit or miss), contracts_first_open_v3
  (a hunt's trophy is shown in person), crafting_tab_repair_v2 (MATERIALS at
  the bench; the trader mends for TC).
- New cards: reinforce_first, workings_first, repair_vendor_first,
  dog_replacement_first, scrap_first, throwables_first, race_ability_first.

The first fight
- The primer is once per INSTALL through useFirstTimeHint (combat_primer_v1):
  the global tips switch and SHOW ALL TIPS AGAIN govern it; closing it still
  latches the per-save milestone. The kill-count gate is gone.
- POWER is taught in the primer (the power_number card is retired); the
  readout card waits for the fight after the first, once the primer is seen.
- FLEE row quotes FLEE_STAMINA_COST and states the failure half; DODGE
  quotes DODGE_COOLDOWN_ROUNDS; STEALTH is rewritten to the handler: before
  contact a passed roll is a free opening (no volley, +5, once per scene),
  once engaged a contest they answer either way.

One optional surface per beat
- useTeachingSlot (useFirstTimeHint.ts) picks the ONE unseen, eligible
  card from a fixed candidate list; presentation order only, each `when` is
  the control's own predicate. ExplorationScreen renders a single
  FirstTimeHint from it; the primer, the mission stinger and the beat card
  defer every candidate. Inventory and Vendor screens do the same.
- climb_first waits for the tutorial to end; torch_first_v2 keys on the
  charged lead; THROW SPEAR keys on spareThrowingSpear (new in
  bandolierEligibility, shared with InputBox).

The outpost and the replay
- Door beat carries one movement-cost sentence; the close names Ask the
  Arbiter once. TutorialOverlay asks isTutorialLocked, so SKIP is offered
  on look / armor / screen_pick too.
- Settings → GUIDANCE → REPLAY TEACHING opens GuidanceScreen ('guidance'
  route): CORE (outpost beats + the corrected screen tour: pity 100, no
  first-install gem, no MAP button, no ACTIONS screen), FIRST-USE (every
  card, grouped, ✓ seen — read-only), REFERENCE (ActionReferenceBody, the
  Action Reference reachable at last).
- Dog onboarding teaches feeding, the decay clock and the permanent walk.
- The bounty primer obeys the tips switch and the reset (install flag via
  isHintSeen / markHintSeen; bountyPrimerSeen still written).

Tests
- New: ota1738TheGameTeachesWhatItRuns (runtime-proven stealth opener,
  spear spend on hit and miss, torch spend, scrap failure yield, tile-step
  cost, dog decay, bounty primer under switch/reset; registry ids; source
  structure of the slot) and ota1738TheReplayAndTheSlot (teaching slot,
  primer "turn off tips", GuidanceScreen read-only with tips off, SKIP pill
  on every locked beat).
- Nine pin suites re-anchored to the registry and the slot (1163, 1205,
  1245, 1249, 1321, 1511, 1523, 1524, 1531).

Reported, not fixed: the typed verb "stealth" parses as `steal` ("Nothing
to steal here"); the STEALTH button submits `sneak`.
